item.title: President Trump’s address to the nation to broadcast and livestream on SCETV
item.description: South Carolina ETV and Public Radio (SCETV) will broadcast and livestream coverage of President Trump’s address to the nation on Dec. 17, scheduled to begin at 9 p.m.

item.title: Alpharetta Beckons with Winter Creativity and Indoor Activities
item.description: Winter in Alpharetta means getting creative, staying active, and savoring the season indoors. Hands-on crafting, live theater, music, comedy and chef-driven meals give locals and travelers of all ages nonstop reasons to head out despite the chill.

item.title: Patriots Point Announces Passing of Former Agency Head and Distinguished Veteran Rear Adm. James H. Flatley III
item.description: Patriots Point Development Authority announces the passing of former agency head and distinguished veteran Rear Adm. James H. Flatley III. Flatley, 91, a longtime Mount Pleasant resident and recipient of South Carolina’s highest civilian honor

item.title: Lowcountry Land Trust Strengthens Leadership Team with Kate Parks Schaefer
item.description: Lowcountry Land Trust, a nonprofit committed to preserving Lowcountry landscapes and waterways for current and future generations, is proud to announce the appointment of Kate Parks Schaefer (pictured) as its chief conservation officer

item.title: Charleston Animal Society and Hendrick Charleston Team Up on "Home for the Holidays!"
item.description: The holiday season is all about coming home — and in 2025, Charleston Animal Society and Hendrick Charleston are making it easier than ever for homeless pets to do just that.

item.title: Credit One Charleston Open Wins 2025 WTA 500 Tournament of the Year
item.description: The Credit One Charleston Open, North America’s largest women’s-only professional tennis event, was announced today as the WTA 500 Tournament of the Year for the fourth consecutive year.

item.title: BofA Names Communities in Schools of South Carolina its Lowcountry 2025 Neighborhood Builder
item.description: Bank of America has named Communities in Schools of South Carolina (CISSC) as its 2025 Neighborhood Builder® for its efforts in collaboration with schools and families to provide on-site student support and connections to resources

item.title: Matador House: Creators in Residency Myrtle Beach Premieres on Matador Network
item.description: Exclusive content documenting a one-of-a-kind creator residency in South Carolina is now available to watch via Matador Network. "Matador House: Creators in Residency Myrtle Beach" chronicles the experiences of eight diverse creatives
